newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Packer's PBL sees higher yr profits.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Packer's PBL sees higher yr profits.

text.p: Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd said on Monday that it expected higher earnings before interest and tax from its television and magazine operations in the current financial year.
"Turning to the current year, television ratings have continued to be excellent, particularly in Sydney and Melbourne," PBL chairman Brian Powers said at the annual general meeting.
"In magazines, our major titles have maintained their leadership positions in their respective markets. However, the advertising market has yet to regain any real vitality."

"Notwithstanding this fact, I am pleased to report that we still expect both television and magazines to post an increase in earnings before interest and taxes for the year, although the quantum of that increase is impossible to predict at this stage," he said.
